translations.web: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
translations.bsb: “Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!”
translations.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
translations.asv: Can any man forbid the water, that these should not be baptized, who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we?
